settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Get alerts on this device, for example when a timer has been running for a long time. Notifications are personal and only apply to you.

status.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
status.noWorker: Notifications need the app to run as an installed web app. That is not active in development mode.
status.notConfigured: Push notifications are not set up on this service yet.
status.iosNeedsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work when Baby Atlas is added to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later). Add the app, and open it from there to turn notifications on.
status.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or phone settings, then come back here.
status.off: Notifications are off on this device.
status.on: Notifications are on for this device.

toast.testNoSubscription: This device has no active notification registration. Turn notifications on first.
toast.testRateLimited: Wait a moment before sending another test notification.
toast.testUnavailable: Push notifications are not set up on the service yet.
toast.testFailed: The notification did not arrive. Try turning notifications off and on again.
toast.saveFailed: Could not save the notification settings

kinds.title: What do you want to be notified about?

TIMER_RUNNING.label: Timer running for a long time
TIMER_RUNNING.description: When a sleep, nursing or other timer looks like it was forgotten.

MEDICINE_NEXT_DOSE.label: Medicine
MEDICINE_NEXT_DOSE.description: When the earliest next dose time you have set is reached.

FEED_DUE.label: Feed coming up
FEED_DUE.description: An estimate based on earlier feeds, shortly before the next one is expected.

NAP_DUE.label: Nap coming up
NAP_DUE.description: An estimate based on age and earlier sleep, shortly before the next nap is expected.

CHECKUP_REMINDER.label: Health station
CHECKUP_REMINDER.description: The day before an appointment you have added, and when it is time to book one.

VACCINE_REMINDER.label: Vaccines
VACCINE_REMINDER.description: When a vaccine in the childhood vaccination programme is due.

WEEKLY_DIGEST.label: Weekly summary
WEEKLY_DIGEST.description: Sunday evening: how the week went compared with the week before.

WEEKLY_TIP.label: Tip of the week
WEEKLY_TIP.description: One short tip that fits your child's age.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.description: You get no notifications during this time. Notifications that are still relevant arrive afterwards.

mute.title: Mute children
mute.description: No notifications about children you mute.
mute.none: You have no children to mute yet.

timerThresholds.summary: Advanced: when a timer counts as forgotten
timerThresholds.description: You get a first notification when a timer has run this long, and another when it has run twice as long. An empty value uses the default.
timerThresholds.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440.
